trigger.about: pyarrow.csv.write_csv + read_csv with default ParseOptions (ignore_empty_lines=True): a null in a one-column table is written as an empty line and skipped on read

summary: pyarrow.csv.write_csv writes a null of a single-column table as an empty line; read_csv skips empty lines by default, so null rows silently disappear on a write/read round trip
